title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar

messages.subject: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some insight into our cost environment: AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

Currently, our offer stands at a price of €5.99 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 12 months, no Preisgleitklausel. 

As an alternative at our standard terms, we can offer a price of €5.92 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, no Preisgleitklausel. To offer you this improved price of €5.92, we must maintain our standard 30-day payment terms, as 90 days would necessitate a higher unit price. 

Please note that a binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? For your planning, our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. Please keep in mind that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Part 370010 – 24-month package and current alloy index
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for the revised offer. To answer your volume question: we can commit to 94,800 kg per year for 24 months, which is 189,600 kg in total.

AS-14404 fell from 3182.6744 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06) to 3007.8019 (idx:AS-14404@2026-09), a change of -5.49%.
PPI-C2431 fell from 131.9 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05) to 129.1 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08), a change of -2.12%.

We understand your alloy requirement is covered at fixed prices until March 2027. A 24-month commitment therefore gives you secure volume against largely known costs.

Please review the attached packages. Could you also tell us whether a cheaper bar variant is available?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Part 370010 – 24-month package and current alloy index
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Our current Angebot is a price of €5.33 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our offer remains valid for 30 days.

We are pleased to accept the 24-month volume commitment and 60-day payment terms, but we must include an AS-14404 index clause for a contract of this length, which allows us to offer €5.45 per unit. For this alternative option, we present a price of €5.45 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

We have verified the index changes you cited; however, since our alloy requirement is covered at fixed prices until March 2027, the recent drop in AS-14404 does not reduce our current costs. As to the index change data you cited, that is not our reality: our AS-14404 is covered at fixed prices until March 2027, so that fall does not reach our cost. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains.

Regarding your technical inquiry, our specialists will reach out to discuss whether a more cost-effective bar variant is suitable for your application. From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.24 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.05 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.03 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: 1.4404 bar: revised packages for 24/36 months
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for the revised offer. We can commit to 94,800 kg per year for 24 months, or 36 months if you prefer.

Your scorecard sc:70710@2026Q3 shows on-time delivery of 88.0%, below a level that would justify a price premium.

Your alloy needs are covered at fixed prices until March 2027. An AS-14404 clause from the first day therefore adds no protection for you. If you need the clause, a 5% deadband is fair.

We propose three packages: a fixed price with 90 days payment, a 5% deadband with 90 days, and a 36-month term with a 3% deadband. Please make your preferred package your primary standing offer. Is a cheaper bar variant available?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: 1.4404 bar: revised packages for 24/36 months
messages.body:
Dear customer,

It is always a pleasure working with you, and we truly value our ongoing partnership! We have verified the delivery record you cited; however, our overall service level remains robust and does not justify a price discount. Our current defect rate for you is about 50 ppm. Regarding your technical inquiry, we currently do not offer a cheaper bar variant that meets your required specifications. From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.24 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.05 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.03 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

We accept the 90-day payment terms for a 24-month contract, but we must include the AS-14404 index clause, as a fixed price over this period is not feasible. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.

Here is our current proposal: a price of €5.31 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This Angebot is valid for 7 days.

Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.43 per unit, with a price of €5.43 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
